They know what that means for them.|__0__, posting on the Cularin holonet node regarding an alleged Thaereian military plot.|<ref name="destabilization">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20040105|text=Destabilization}}</ref>}}
The handle '''__0__''' was the user ID of an individual active on the [[Cularin holonet node]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of [[Operation False Horizon]], the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Tiny.f]] shared on a Cularin holonet node forum a purported communique from [[Jir Tramsig]],<ref name="destabilization" /> the leader of [[Thaereian military]] security forces stationed in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]],<ref name="Over Thaere">{{Wizards|url=rpga/livingforce/article.asp?x=lf/swlf20011004b_thaere&c=swlfc|text=Over Thaere}}</ref> indicating that the [[Thaereian]]s were deliberately causing social and economic destabilization in the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. In response, __0__ claimed in a message on the forum that their sources had confirmed the evidence shared regarding the Thaereian plot to be genuine and that the Thaereians had deliberately allowed the message to be circulated, to spark public anger. The post by __0__ reported a holonet node post location of 0.0.0 which caused confusion among user [[mstrslcr]] regarding how it was possible to report such a location; the user [[l337b0i]] then demonstrated that it was possible to spoof a node location to falsely report as 0.0.0.<ref name="destabilization" />
